meaningBoundary: All thirteen numeric generator routes, both quality-threshold paths and both helper-root zero/unordered skip-division paths are proved by decoding their complete scalar arithmetic into expression trees, with exact helper arguments and opaque helper returns. Raw coefficient order and the independently proved wrapper normalization are preserved. Ordinary numerical arithmetic assumes finite inputs and strictly positive finite power-helper returns; exceptional paths establish expressions and branch predicates, not full NaN payload/exception behavior. Completing SSE comparisons, callee-saved register preservation and nonzero normalization denominator are conditional. Trigonometric/power numerical equivalence, theoretical response names, other revisions/default profile resolution, allocation and live activation are not established.
